```{r setup, include=FALSE, error=TRUE}
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
library(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86)
library(phastCons100way.UCSC.hg38)
library(parallel)
library(TFBlearner)
library(data.table)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(BiocParallel)

seed <- params$seed
set.seed(seed)

setDTthreads(as.integer(params$threads))
```

# Add Context-Features

## Load MultiAssayExperiment Object

```{r, context-features - basic object}
mae <- readRDS(params$maePath)
outDir <- params$outDir
mae <- panContextFeatures(mae, seed=seed, saveHdf5=TRUE, 
                          outDir=file.path("..", outDir))
saveRDS(mae, file.path("..", params$outPath))
```

```{r, session info}
sessionInfo()
```
